title: INGRESS — importing M3 change events
summary: Explore of the INGRESS handler inside the Ingress container: supported M3 change events are persisted as ingress models and snapshot rebuilds are requested on the snapshot queue. Snapshot composition belongs to the SNAPSHOT handler and appears here only as the boundary queue. Arrows explain responsibilities, never execution order or observed events.
